newsitem.title: CHINA: China state firm profits down 36.1 pct Jan-July.
newsitem.headline: China state firm profits down 36.1 pct Jan-July.

text.p: Total profits made by China's state-owned industrial enterprises dropped by 36.1 percent in the first seven months of this year compared with the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bureau said on Tuesday.

It gave no details of the falling profits by China's lumbering state firms but said the most critical issue facing the Chinese economy was low economic efficiency, especially among state-owned enterprises.
Officials have said that as many as 70 percent of China's estimated 100,000 state enterprises are running at a loss, with about 40 percent chronically in the red.
